answer: Charge every agent identity a steady demurrage upkeep fee that slowly bleeds idle holdings. One honest node pays a single clear stream, crystal-simple; a sybil operator must feed N parallel upkeep streams at once. Phantom identities drain away like rain vanishing through karst limestone, and a clone swarm's budget cracks like a walnut under the compounding recurring cost, so flooding the economy with fakes becomes cash-flow-negative rather than cheap.
